purpose: Independent generic confound-control arm. Entries are broad algorithm/backend families, not task-specific solver code, task identities, payloads, answers, or tuned constants.

entries.name: native_boolean_optimization_backend
allowed_mechanisms: OR-Tools CP-SAT when exact integer/Boolean formulation is mechanically derivable
entries.restriction: No task-specific branching heuristic or hand-derived problem reduction may be added after task identity is known.

entries.name: certified_bitset_graph_search
entries.restriction: May instantiate clique/independent-set style search only when an exact mechanical reduction and inverse mapping are certified from source semantics before official training. No instance-tuned ordering constants.

entries.name: optimized_native_numeric_backend
entries.restriction: Only public general-purpose library APIs; no public solver implementation for the selected task may be inspected.

entries.name: independent_convex_solver_backend
allowed_mechanisms: closed-form generic projection primitives already frozen before selection
entries.restriction: No task-specific algebraic derivation authored after task identity is known.

entries.name: specialized_linear_algebra_backend
allowed_mechanisms: sparse linear algebra when source structure mechanically exposes sparsity
entries.restriction: No task-specific symbolic reformulation beyond mechanically certified shape/sparsity reduction.

entries.name: native_bytes_crypto_compression_backend
entries.restriction: No altered algorithm/format semantics and no task-specific external implementation lookup.

coverage_fallback: If no catalog entry applies, use the strongest independently available source-equivalent/native-backend implementation that can be selected without public task-specific solver access; mark strong_baseline_coverage_limited=true. Such a task can pass ordinary correctness/clean gates but cannot count as a baseline-qualified causal win unless the fallback is valid on the full blind denominator.
